scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: VB.NET typed loop sum
checks.code:
Imports System

Module Museum
Sub Main()
Dim total As Integer = 0
For n As Integer = 1 To 10
 total += n
Next
Console.WriteLine(total)
End Sub
End Module

checks.name: VB.NET typed function
checks.code:
Imports System
Module Museum
Function Square(n As Integer) As Integer
Return n * n
End Function
Sub Main()
Console.WriteLine(Square(7))
End Sub
End Module

checks.name: VB.NET LINQ standard library
checks.code:
Imports System
Imports System.Linq
Module Museum
Sub Main()
Console.WriteLine(Enumerable.Range(1,10).Sum())
End Sub
End Module

checks.name: VB.NET multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code:
Imports System

Module Museum
Sub Main()
Console.InputEncoding = New System.Text.UTF8Encoding(False)
Console.OutputEncoding = New System.Text.UTF8Encoding(False)
For n As Integer = 1 To 2
 Console.WriteLine("[" & Console.ReadLine() & "]")
Next
End Sub
End Module

checks.name: VB.NET strict type error prevents execution
checks.code:
Imports System

Module Museum
Sub Main()
Console.WriteLine("MUST_NOT_RUN")
Dim n As Integer = "wrong"
Console.WriteLine(n)
End Sub
End Module

/work/Main.vb(6) : error BC30512: Option Strict On disallows implicit conversions from 'String' to 'Integer'.

Dim n As Integer = "wrong"
                   ~~~~~~~

checks.name: VB.NET unhandled exception fails
checks.code:
Imports System

Module Museum
Sub Main()
Throw New Exception("intentional error")
End Sub
End Module

checks.name: VB.NET handled exception succeeds
checks.code:
Imports System

Module Museum
Sub Main()
Try
 Throw New Exception("expected")
Catch e As Exception
 Console.WriteLine("handled")
End Try
End Sub
End Module
